gloss: to begin to fall (rain, snow); to start raining/snowing

definitions.gloss: to begin to fall (rain, snow); to start raining or snowing
definitions.explanation: Describes the onset of precipitation — the moment when rain, snow, or other precipitation starts falling. A common compound verb using the V-stem + 始める pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}めるらしい。
examples.english: I hear it's going to start snowing from evening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}め、⟦{中断|ちゅうだん}→中断：05218_chuudan⟧になった。
examples.english: Heavy rain began falling in the middle of the game, and it was suspended.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧ (to fall — rain, snow) and {始|はじ}める (to begin). Describes the onset of precipitation. This is a natural and very common compound using the V-stem + {始|はじ}める pattern that means "to start doing."

USAGE:
The subject is always a form of precipitation (⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧, ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧, ⟦{雹|ひょう}→雹：17632_hyou⟧, etc.), marked by が.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}める: to start raining
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}める: to start snowing
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}める: to suddenly start falling
- ポツポツ{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}める: to start falling in scattered drops

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}す→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧: to start falling (rain/snow) — very similar, slightly more sudden/colloquial
- ⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: to fall (rain/snow) — the base verb, without the inceptive meaning
- ⟦{降|ふ}り{止|や}む→降り止む：27987_furiyamu⟧: to stop falling — the opposite, precipitation ending
